transactions.notes: CROSS-YEAR DUPLICATE (per spec explicit guidance): this is the SAME deal as N2IU FY2023's announced divestment of Mapletree Anson (announced as a subsequent event in the FY2023 AR, completed 31 Jul 2024, within this FY2024 reporting period) — same deal_id used across both years' rebuild files, keyed to the COMPLETION year (2024). GAIN FIGURE DIFFERS BY YEAR, both preserved as-disclosed rather than reconciled: the FY2023 AR (announced, pre-completion) disclosed an expected/announced gain of S$10,000,000 over the S$765.0m independent valuation as at 31 Mar 2024; THIS report (FY2024, post-completion/actual) discloses the REALISED net gain on divestment as S$4,006,000 (after transaction costs — net proceeds S$762,448k vs sale consideration S$775.0m). The disclosed PREMIUM PERCENTAGE (1.31% = 10.0m/765.0m) is consistent across both years since it is computed from the same gross consideration (S$775.0m) and same independent valuation (S$765.0m, as at 31 Mar 2024) — it is the S$10.0m headline gain-over-valuation figure that differs from the S$4.006m realised accounting gain (the latter nets off transaction/disposal costs and is not the figure gain_loss_pct is derived from). reference_basis = valuation (explicitly 'independent valuation'), and this coincidentally equals the carrying value removed on disposal (765,000 in both disclosures, verified genuine coincidence not a data conflation, per prior extraction's round-8 null-recovery note) — book_value was not used as an alternative basis since the AR's own premium language anchors to 'independent valuation'. AR also discloses a separate S$95.0m premium over the ORIGINAL PURCHASE PRICE of S$680.0m (=14.0%) — not used here since 'valuation' is the disclosed reference for the 1.31%/S$10.0m figure quoted in the headline narrative (p13, p41).
